README: how to play (keys, words), kept files in the --kept folder, headless and frame commands, both used as written for every check.

defects: The headless run prints its JSON with ensure_ascii=False in the console code page (cp1252 here), not UTF-8: a reader decoding UTF-8 fails on Spanish texts (I had to decode as cp1252), and a character outside the code page would crash the print.
The frame font is ASCII only: Spanish accents are dropped in the PNG (README says so).
The window mode (play) was never run by the builder and was not run here (it opens a window).

trace.how: context, new, read_again and how far the context grew are the run's own records. written_out a request is its growth less its answers (characters / 4), scaled to the run's exact total; of_which_unseen is that less the visible text (thinking). cost is what the request read and wrote, weighted; carried is what reading again what it added cost at every later request (start.carried: the same for what every request starts from). reading + writing is in_the_ledger
